text:
mina: Hey team — Mina here, day 0 on Platform. Trying to get a tiny dev GKE cluster up in asia-southeast1 for a spike and I'm blocked by two things: I can't create a service account with the right permission set, and when I try to reserve a regional IP I get quota errors. Who should I ping for quota increases vs IAM role grants?

samir: welcome Mina! For quotas ping cloud-oncall first (they have the automation), for IAM either @olivia or me depending on if it's a project role or org role. What exact error are you seeing?

mina: thanks. For quotas I see: "Quota 'IN_USE_ADDRESSES' exceeded for region asia-southeast1" when creating a static IP. For IAM when I run: 
```
gcloud iam service-accounts create mina-dev-sa --display-name="Mina dev SA"
```
I get an error: "Permission 'iam.serviceAccounts.create' denied on resource project/my-dev-project (or the resource may not exist)"

olivia: cool — for the IP quota we need to file the quota request (we can auto-approve small dev requests). @cloud-oncall-bot can you open a quota ticket for region asia-southeast1 IN_USE_ADDRESSES for project my-dev-project with requested 10 ips?

cloud-oncall-bot: Received request: create-quota-ticket project=my-dev-project region=asia-southeast1 quota=IN_USE_ADDRESSES requested=10 requester=mina status=queued. ETA: ~2 business days for manual review, can escalate if urgent.

mina: 2 days is a bit long for a quick spike — is there any fallback region or workaround?

ben: You can try asia-northeast1 or us-central1 if latency isn't critical. Also, if you're just testing, we can attach an ephemeral external IP or use clusterIP services behind the internal load balancer. If you want a faster path we can temporarily borrow an IP from our dev pool, but that needs infra approval.

mina: ok I'll try asia-northeast1 as a stopgap. On the IAM side, I actually need to provision a service account that will be used by a CICD runner. Which roles should I request? I only need minimal permissions to create and manage GKE node pools and pull images from our Artifact Registry.

olivia: For a CI/CD SA we usually grant: roles/container.nodeServiceAccount (or a custom role), roles/container.admin only if you need cluster admin actions. For Artifact Registry: roles/artifactregistry.reader. We prefer custom least-priv roles — open to specifics of your pipeline. If it's cross-project, we'll need an org-level binding or a workload identity setup.

mina: thanks. It's cross-project: repo lives in infra-repos but the cluster will be in my-dev-project. I think Workload Identity is better than long-lived keys.

samir: yep Workload Identity is the recommended pattern. For cross-project SA creation you'll need iam.serviceAccounts.create on my-dev-project and iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on infra-repos project for the runner. I can add you to a PR granting the minimum permissions if you paste the exact role list you want.

mina: role list: [roles/iam.serviceAccountUser on infra-repos, roles/artifactregistry.reader on my-dev-project, roles/compute.networkUser on my-dev-project, roles/container.nodeServiceAccount on my-dev-project]. Please correct if too broad.

olivia: That looks reasonable. Swap roles/compute.networkUser for a more specific VPC access role if you can (we have a VPC-connector role). I'll vet and propose a custom role for node SA to remove excess permissions.

samir: I'll start a PR to grant you iam.serviceAccounts.create on my-dev-project and add the actAs binding needed for Workload Identity. @mina I'll CC you.

mina: amazing, thank you both! One last Q: do I need any AWS access for this spike? I'm seeing a note in the onboarding doc about AWS org invite for credential rotation — unsure if it's required now.

ben: not for GKE. The AWS org invite is for teams that operate on AWS infra. You don't need AWS access unless your workload talks to an AWS service or we use cross-cloud infra. We do still invite everyone for SSO baseline.

mina: got it. If cloud-oncall-bot has ETA ~2 days for the quota, and samir opens the IAM PR, I'm unblocked enough to try asia-northeast1. I'll update the thread after I try. Thanks all :confetti_ball:

samir: ping if you need a fast IP borrow — can usually approve for dev spikes.

olivia: tagging onboarding-docs: we should add a short section on preferred APAC fallback regions to help new hires.

mina: noted — happy to draft a blurb once I'm up and running.

cloud-oncall-bot: quota-ticket 1967800001 created and linked to this thread. Status: queued.

mina: closing the loop — switched region to asia-northeast1 and cluster created successfully. IAM PR merged for the needed rights. Leaving a short doc snippet in #docs-onboarding in 1hr. Thanks! :tada:
